changelog: The voice keyboard now has Pause / Resume, like Gboard's new voice-typing toolbar and the main app's v7.5 pause: while dictating in WhatsApp or Messenger, tap the mic to pause (words stay, session kept) and tap it again to resume where you left off. A small stop button appears next to the mic while dictating — that is now the only way to end the session, so the mic never stops dictation by accident.
